title: Rumoured deep underground military bases

tellings.quote: and there are rumors of deep underground military bases from Edwards to Nellis to Peterson and Colorado and and Cheyenne Mountain Complex norat

plain: There are rumours of deep underground military bases stretching from Edwards and Nellis, two US Air Force bases in the western desert, to Peterson in Colorado and the Cheyenne Mountain Complex, the mountain bunker in Colorado that houses NORAD, the North American Aerospace Defense Command. Michels brings this up himself as rumour, without naming a source, in an episode about a government research scientist who says he was abducted. If true, it would mean the military keeps hidden facilities far below some of its best-known bases.
